claim: **他断言商品的可交换价值由获得它所需的劳动量决定，并把「有用性」逐出价值尺度（只留作必要条件）**：《原理》第一章先立定义——`Possessing utility, commodities derive their ex- changeable value from two sources: from their scarcity, and from the quantity of labour required to obtain them.`（`ex- changeable` 为断行连字符照录）；紧接着把有用性降级——`Utility then is not the measure of exchangeable value, although it is absolutely essential to it.`；面对 Malthus 的价值尺度之争（1823），他仍以「劳动量变动」为共同尺度，但承认比例难题——`There is no such thing ; your measure as well as mine will measure variations arising from more or leas labour being required to produce commodities, but the difficulty is respecting the varying proportions which go to labour and profits.`（`leas`＝less 之 OCR 讹形照录）。　［出处：《政治经济学及赋税原理》1821 三版 Ch.I（src-223af918b1a2）；致 Malthus 书信（src-23315b56db3b）］

claim: **他分析经济现象时，先把暂时与偶然的效应搁到一边，把注意力钉在由此产生的永久状态（长期均衡）上——这是他自述与 Malthus 分歧的根源**：致 Malthus 信里他亲自点名两人思维的差别——`one great cause of our difference in opinion on the subjects which we have so often d'mrmsod is that yon have always in your mind the immediate and temporary effects of particular changes, whereas I put these immediate and temporary effects quite aside, and fix my whole attention on the permanent state of things which will result from them.`（`d'mrmsod`＝discussed、`yon`＝you 之 OCR 讹形照录）；同一「长期均衡」思维在《答 Bosanquet》里表现为：超额利润必被竞争压回一般利润率——`That theory takes for granted, that whenever enormous pro- fits can be made in any particular trade, a sufficient number of capitalists will be in- duced to engage in it, who will, by their competition, reduce the profits to the ge- neral rate of mercantile gains.`（断行连字符照录）。　［出处：致 Malthus 书信（src-23315b56db3b）；Reply to Mr. Bosanquet 1811（src-ab6006937cf3）］

claim: **边界：不可把 Ricardo 当作现代宏观经济学/央行政策/计量方法的直接来源——他的分析是「先定因→假设→算术算例→定性命题」的古典政治经济学，且自认不存在完美价值尺度**：他对 Malthus 坦言——`for these variations there has never been, and I think never will be, any perfect measure of value.`；《金块高价》把方法落在「先无歧义地定因，再谈补救」上——`Be- fore any remedy can be successfully applied to an evil of such magnitude, it is essential that there should be no doubt as to its cause.`（`Be- fore` 断行连字符照录）；其 1816 金块方案是「按造币厂价兑付金块+发行看金价」的古典信用纪律，不是现代央行的利率/通胀目标工具，也从未给出计量估计。　［出处：致 Malthus 书信（src-23315b56db3b）；The High Price of Bullion 1810（src-65463ac971fb）］

claim: **两个可指认的盲区：①劳动价值论面对「劳动与利润比例变动」时的尺度难题，他自己承认深陷迷宫、至死未解——这正是后来劳动价值论现代批判的落点；②机器对总产量与就业的损害，他起初未预见、1821 三版才公开改口**：致 McCulloch 信（1823）自白——`The difficult subject of value has engaged my thoughts but without my being able satisfactorily to find my way out of the labyrinth.`；论机器一章他交代改口——`The whole change of my opinion is simply this: I formerly thought that machinery en- abled a country to add annually to the gross produce of its commodities, and I now think that the use of it rather tends to the diminution of the gross produce.`（`en- abled` 断行连字符照录）；同一价值论一侧，他亦坚决否认普遍过剩，对需求不足论一贯抗议——`It is against this latter doctrine that I protest, and give my decided opposition.`（Say 定律一侧的盲区）。　［出处：致 McCulloch 书信（src-47d7fb0a92a7）；致 Malthus 书信（src-23315b56db3b）］

被问他对机器的看法变过没有

evidence_clusters: 致 McCulloch 书信 1823：价值难题深陷迷宫
